name: asm2asm_arm_bench_03
description: Benchmark for evaluating models on ARM assembly-to-assembly transformations and generation, measuring whether generated assembly preserves intended semantics and matches target sequences. Contains paired examples of input and expected assembly outputs for low-level code-transformation tasks used to assess model capability on assembly code synthesis and translation.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited adoption, used mainly by researchers working on low-level code generation, compilers, and binary analysis.
